-- Die 200 bereits geholten Buchungen wurden mit der falschen
-- Teilnehmerzaehlung geschrieben. Sie werden erneut zum Abruf freigegeben.
UPDATE edoobox_raw.booking
SET detail_synced_at = NULL
WHERE is_deleted = false;

SELECT count(*) AS wieder_offen
FROM edoobox_raw.booking
WHERE is_deleted = false AND detail_synced_at IS NULL;

-- Alle offenen Buchungen auf einmal. Keine Schleife.
SELECT booking_id
FROM edoobox_raw.booking
WHERE is_deleted = false
  AND detail_synced_at IS NULL
ORDER BY booking_time DESC NULLS LAST;

=WITH stapel AS (
    SELECT booking_id
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoIds${{ $json.alleKennungenJson }}$edoIds$::jsonb)
         AS s(booking_id text)
),
eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoJson${{ $json.datenJson }}$edoJson$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            booking_id     text,
            offer_id       text,
            promotion_id   text,
            is_b2b         boolean,
            is_multi_offer boolean,
            teilnehmer_aktiv integer,
            teilnehmer_gesamt integer,
            positionen     jsonb,
            vorgaenge      jsonb
         )
),
positionen AS (
    SELECT e.booking_id, p.*
    FROM eingang e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(e.positionen)
         AS p(
            pricecategory_id   text,
            pricecategory_name text,
            amount_net         numeric(12,2),
            currency           char(3),
            quantity           integer,
            is_default         boolean
         )
),
positionen_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.booking_position AS bp (
        booking_id, pricecategory_id, pricecategory_name,
        amount_net, currency, quantity, is_default, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT booking_id, pricecategory_id, pricecategory_name,
           amount_net, currency, quantity, is_default, now()
    FROM positionen
    ON CONFLICT (booking_id, pricecategory_id) DO UPDATE
    SET pricecategory_name = EXCLUDED.pricecategory_name,
        amount_net         = EXCLUDED.amount_net,
        currency           = EXCLUDED.currency,
        quantity           = EXCLUDED.quantity,
        is_default         = EXCLUDED.is_default,
        last_synced_at     = now()
    RETURNING bp.position_id
),
vorgaenge AS (
    SELECT e.booking_id, v.*
    FROM eingang e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(e.vorgaenge)
         AS v(
            transaction_id     text,
            transaction_number text,
            amount             numeric(12,2),
            currency           char(3)
         )
),
vorgaenge_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.booking_transaction AS bt (
        transaction_id, booking_id, transaction_number,
        amount, currency, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT transaction_id, booking_id, transaction_number,
           amount, currency, now()
    FROM vorgaenge
    ON CONFLICT (transaction_id) DO UPDATE
    SET booking_id         = EXCLUDED.booking_id,
        transaction_number = EXCLUDED.transaction_number,
        amount             = EXCLUDED.amount,
        currency           = EXCLUDED.currency,
        last_synced_at     = now()
    RETURNING bt.transaction_id
),
-- Der Merker wird fuer den gesamten Stapel gesetzt, auch fuer Buchungen
-- ohne Preiskategorie. Sonst liefe die Schleife endlos.
abgehakt AS (
    -- Eine einzige Aktualisierung der Tabelle booking. Zwei getrennte
    -- Bloecke auf dieselbe Zeile werden von PostgreSQL nicht nacheinander
    -- ausgefuehrt, einer davon bliebe wirkungslos.
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.booking b
    SET detail_synced_at = now(),
        last_synced_at   = now(),
        is_b2b           = coalesce(e.is_b2b,         b.is_b2b),
        is_multi_offer   = coalesce(e.is_multi_offer, b.is_multi_offer),
        offer_id         = coalesce(e.offer_id,       b.offer_id)
    FROM stapel s
    LEFT JOIN eingang e ON e.booking_id = s.booking_id
    WHERE b.booking_id = s.booking_id
    RETURNING b.booking_id, (e.booking_id IS NOT NULL) AS mit_detail
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM abgehakt)                            AS stapel_abgehakt,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM abgehakt WHERE mit_detail)           AS mit_detail,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM positionen_geschrieben)              AS positionen,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM vorgaenge_geschrieben)               AS vorgaenge;
